messages:
zoe: post-deploy lighthouse probe (latency-lighthouse) showing p95 jump in us-west-2 since +release v2.4. Rollout at 80%. request: pause ramp and pin at 50% while we triage.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: postdeploy-check latency-lighthouse region=us-west-2 p95=1.8s baseline=700ms errors=2 canary=80%.

james: noted. are errors originating from gateway or model?

sara: running `redwoodctl trace query --probe latency-lighthouse --region us-west-2 --last 15m` now.

sara: looks like increased queue_time on gateway-proxy-7; model p95 similar across variants.

zoe: suggests routing 30% of traffic to previous gateway deploy to isolate. can we do that without touching model variants?

ops-bot: ops-bot: routing change requested by zoe. apply route split gateway-usw2 new:70 old:30. confirm y/n

james: y - do it.

ops-bot: ops-bot: route-split applied. `redwoodctl route update gateway/us-west-2 --split new=70,old=30` -> ok.

ops-bot: metric update in 5m: new p95=1.6s old p95=750ms. error delta small.

sara: with split we can see gateway is the weak link. recommend rollback gateway in us-west-2 to previous build (build-20240321-7).

zoe: agree. given change window ends in 25m, proceed with rollback for just us-west-2 gateway. will keep model variant pinned.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollback: component=gateway region=us-west-2 target=build-20240321-7 window=rolling-5m. starting in 2m.

james: executing rollback steps in runbook 3.2. notifying SRE page.

ops-bot: rollback completed. postdeploy smoke: latency-lighthouse p95=720ms errors=0.

zoe: closing rollout. adding note to release notes: "v2.4 partial gateway rollback in us-west-2 due to postdeploy latency probe; model serving unchanged." will follow-up with postmortem if recurring.

sara: created issue: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/2145 with traces and grafana link https://grafana.redwood/latency-lighthouse.

james: thanks all. I'll update the change log and notify comms.

zoe: thread will be archived after 1h if no regressions.
